coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-04-11, 2020-04-16, 2021-04-15, 2022-04-14, 2023-04-13, 2024-04-11, 2025-04-10, 2026-04-09), one table per calendar fiscal year FY2018-FY2025: 80 non-employee director rows (FY2018 9, FY2019 10, FY2020 10, FY2021 11, FY2022 9, FY2023 10, FY2024 11, FY2025 10). Every table has a single Stock Awards column and no Total column, because Amazon pays directors no cash and grants a three-year RSU award about once every three years; rows printed '—' are recorded as 0, and total = stock awards. Employee directors (Bezos in every table, plus Jassy from FY2021) are printed with '—' and a footnote saying they get no pay for board service (d111-d118); those 13 rows are excluded as not director pay. Rows were parsed from sec_text output and each quote is the full printed row with its footnote marker. Not recorded: the PRE 14As of 2020-03-27 and 2022-04-01 (preliminary, not definitive) and the DEFA14A supplements. No 10-K/A was filed 2019-2026 (EDGAR submissions feed through 2026-10-06).
